{'text': '新土地業權註冊制度將於明年上半年實施，', 'paragraph_context': 'The new land title registration system will be implemented in the first half of next year. The government has also tightened existing land search arrangements, requiring that searches meet nine "specified purposes." Among these, news purposes are not explicitly listed, and applicants may only apply on the grounds of "public interest," declaring that the search records will be used solely for the declared purpose and explaining how the records will be used to achieve that purpose, subject to the Land Registrar\'s "individual consideration." If the Registrar is not satisfied, the application must be refused, and false or misleading statements carry criminal liability. The subsidiary legislation was gazetted last Friday (the 16th) and enacted using the "enact-then-review" procedure. The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) submitted its views to the authorities today, urging the Legislative Council to consider and timely amend the legislation, and demanding the government withdraw and restore the original unrestricted status of land record searches.'}{'text': '政府一併收緊現行土地查冊安排', 'paragraph_context': 'The new land title registration system will be implemented in the first half of next year. The government has also tightened existing land search arrangements, requiring that searches meet nine "specified purposes." Among these, news purposes are not explicitly listed, and applicants may only apply on the grounds of "public interest," declaring that the search records will be used solely for the declared purpose and explaining how the records will be used to achieve that purpose, subject to the Land Registrar\'s "individual consideration." If the Registrar is not satisfied, the application must be refused, and false or misleading statements carry criminal liability. The subsidiary legislation was gazetted last Friday (the 16th) and enacted using the "enact-then-review" procedure. The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) submitted its views to the authorities today, urging the Legislative Council to consider and timely amend the legislation, and demanding the government withdraw and restore the original unrestricted status of land record searches.'}{'text': '，須符合九項「指明目的」才可查冊。當中未有列明新聞用途，僅供以「公眾利益」為由申請，申請人須聲明查冊紀錄僅用於聲明目的、並說明如何使用紀錄以達致聲明目的，由土地註冊處長「個別考慮」；若處長不信納須拒絕，涉虛假或誤導陳述須負刑責。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new land title registration system will be implemented in the first half of next year. The government has also tightened existing land search arrangements, requiring that searches meet nine "specified purposes." Among these, news purposes are not explicitly listed, and applicants may only apply on the grounds of "public interest," declaring that the search records will be used solely for the declared purpose and explaining how the records will be used to achieve that purpose, subject to the Land Registrar\'s "individual consideration." If the Registrar is not satisfied, the application must be refused, and false or misleading statements carry criminal liability. The subsidiary legislation was gazetted last Friday (the 16th) and enacted using the "enact-then-review" procedure. The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) submitted its views to the authorities today, urging the Legislative Council to consider and timely amend the legislation, and demanding the government withdraw and restore the original unrestricted status of land record searches.'}

Among these, news purposes are not explicitly listed, and applicants may only apply on the grounds of "public interest," declaring that the search records will be used solely for the declared purpose and explaining how the records will be used to achieve that purpose, subject to the Land Registrar\'s "individual consideration." The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) submitted its views to the authorities today, urging the Legislative Council to consider and timely amend the legislation, and demanding the government withdraw and restore the original unrestricted status of land record searches.'}{'text': '，促請立法會考慮和及時作修訂，並要求政府撤回、恢復原來查閱土地紀錄不受限的狀況。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new land title registration system will be implemented in the first half of next year. The government has also tightened existing land search arrangements, requiring that searches meet nine "specified purposes." Among these, news purposes are not explicitly listed, and applicants may only apply on the grounds of "public interest," declaring that the search records will be used solely for the declared purpose and explaining how the records will be used to achieve that purpose, subject to the Land Registrar\'s "individual consideration." If the Registrar is not satisfied, the application must be refused, and false or misleading statements carry criminal liability. The subsidiary legislation was gazetted last Friday (the 16th) and enacted using the "enact-then-review" procedure. The Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) submitted its views to the authorities today, urging the Legislative Council to consider and timely amend the legislation, and demanding the government withdraw and restore the original unrestricted status of land record searches.'}

{'text': '記協在意見書中指，香港市民查閱土地資源最終受益者的公開資料，屬基本權益，方便公眾時刻監察有損公眾利益的事件，而傳媒作為公眾一員，應享有同等權利查閱有關記錄。而香港以市場透明度為傲，當局不應倒行逆施在倉促情況下通過附屬法例，以免窒礙資訊自由和公眾知情權。', 'paragraph_context': "The HKJA stated in its submission that Hong Kong citizens' access to public information on the ultimate beneficiaries of land resources is a fundamental right, facilitating public monitoring of events detrimental to public interest at all times. As members of the public, the media should enjoy the same right to access such records. Hong Kong takes pride in its market transparency, and the authorities should not act in reverse by passing subsidiary legislation in haste, lest it impede the freedom of information and the public's right to know."}

{'text': '記協：新規定下即使涉高官行為，亦需由政府裁定', 'paragraph_context': 'HKJA: Even conduct involving senior officials under the new rules would still require government determination'}

{'text': '發展局文件提到，修訂安排旨在保障個人資料私隱，記協指當局未能提供數據反映過往行之有效的查冊制度如何侵擾私隱，說法不足以支持收緊查冊，「當局不應以一句保障私隱來凌駕公眾的知情權」。就當局指公眾可以「公眾利益」申請查冊，已平衡公眾知情權，記協稱「不敢苟同」。記協認為新規定將削弱香港物業市場透明度，以及公眾對於本港土地利益的知情權。', 'paragraph_context': 'Development Bureau documents stated that the revised arrangements aim to protect personal data privacy. The HKJA pointed out that the authorities failed to provide data reflecting how the previously effective land search system infringed privacy, and that such reasoning is insufficient to support tightening searches: "The authorities should not override the public\'s right to know under the guise of protecting privacy." Regarding the authorities\' claim that the public can apply for searches on "public interest" grounds, which already balances the public\'s right to know, the HKJA said it "cannot agree." The HKJA believes the new rules will weaken the transparency of Hong Kong\'s property market and the public\'s right to know about local land interests.'}

{'text': '記協指新規定下，土地記錄可繼續便利具商業利益者進行買賣交易，而希望監察物業業權、公平交易的公眾或沒有直接利益的人士，卻需通過「特別審批」，將「嚴重妨礙以公開資訊破除利益固化藩籬」，即監察市場運作、權貴濫用土地及物業資源的公眾監察活動。協會舉例如以「公眾利益」進行查冊，即使當中或涉及政府高官的行為，亦需先由政府本身作特別裁定；而且，大部分此類報道一般需在取得土地紀錄後，方能確認涉事詳情是否涉及公眾利益，新規定卻在「證據前落閘」，要求申請方先提供證明方「開閘」，屬於本末倒置。', 'paragraph_context': 'The HKJA pointed out that under the new rules, land records will continue to facilitate those with commercial interests in property transactions, while members of the public who wish to monitor property ownership and fair transactions, or those without direct interests, would need to obtain "special approval." This would "seriously impede using public information to break down entrenched interests," namely public monitoring of market operations and the abuse of land and property resources by the powerful. The association gave examples: to conduct a search under "public interest," even if it involves the conduct of senior government officials, a special determination by the government itself is first required. Moreover, most such reporting generally requires obtaining land records before confirming whether the details involve public interest, yet the new rules "close the gate before the evidence" by requiring applicants to provide proof first before "opening the gate," which is putting the cart before the horse.'}

{'text': '紅山半島山泥傾瀉揭大規模僭建，多間傳媒之後透過土地查冊，揭業主未遵清拆命令。（資料相片）', 'paragraph_context': 'The landslide at Red Hill Peninsula exposed large-scale unauthorized building works. Multiple media outlets later used land searches to reveal that owners had not complied with demolition orders. (File photo)'}

{'text': '記協指調查報道或因行政延誤而消失', 'paragraph_context': 'HKJA says investigative reporting may disappear due to administrative delays'}

{'text': '記協強調，各大傳媒經常需依賴土地查冊核實交易金額、面積等基本資訊，調查報道亦需依賴開放式搜索，查找不正常交易、以至辨識業權人會否涉違法行為，新規定將嚴重影響這類涉公眾利益報道。', 'paragraph_context': 'The HKJA stressed that major media outlets frequently need to rely on land searches to verify basic information such as transaction amounts and areas, and investigative reporting also relies on open searches to identify abnormal transactions and determine whether property owners may be involved in illegal activities. The new rules will severely affect such public-interest reporting.'}

{'text': '協會列舉 18 宗預料在新土地查冊制度下，難以再進行的調查報道例子，包括區議員', 'paragraph_context': 'The association listed 18 examples of investigative reports that would likely no longer be possible under the new land search regime, including district councillor'}{'text': '黃碧嬌涉及宏福苑「死人授權票」', 'paragraph_context': 'The association listed 18 examples of investigative reports that would likely no longer be possible under the new land search regime, including district councillor Wong Bik-kiu being involved in "dead voters\' proxy votes" at Wang Fuk Court; a conglomerate purchasing subdivided flat buildings to convert into simple homes and evicting tenants; large-scale unauthorized building works exposed after the landslide at Red Hill Peninsula following the century\'s heaviest rainfall, with owners ignoring demolition orders; a fraud syndicate ringleader owning luxury homes and commercial building titles in Hong Kong with the Department of Justice issuing a freezing order; the land and properties of senior police officers involved in the 721 incident suspected of illegally occupying government land and unauthorized building works; unauthorized basement construction at former Secretary for Justice Teresa Cheng\'s residence, with her husband Jonathan Scott Poon\'s residence also suspected of unauthorized building works, among others.'}{'text': '；有集團購入劏房大廈改建簡樸房並迫遷租戶；紅山半島在世紀暴雨後山泥傾瀉後揭大規模僭建，業主無視清拆命令；詐騙集團主腦在港擁豪宅、商廈業權，律政司發凍結令；涉 721 事件警隊高層的土地及物業涉霸官地僭建；鄭若驊大宅僭建地庫、丈夫潘樂陶大宅涉僭建等等。', 'paragraph_context': 'The association listed 18 examples of investigative reports that would likely no longer be possible under the new land search regime, including district councillor Wong Bik-kiu being involved in "dead voters\' proxy votes" at Wang Fuk Court; a conglomerate purchasing subdivided flat buildings to convert into simple homes and evicting tenants; large-scale unauthorized building works exposed after the landslide at Red Hill Peninsula following the century\'s heaviest rainfall, with owners ignoring demolition orders; a fraud syndicate ringleader owning luxury homes and commercial building titles in Hong Kong with the Department of Justice issuing a freezing order; the land and properties of senior police officers involved in the 721 incident suspected of illegally occupying government land and unauthorized building works; unauthorized basement construction at former Secretary for Justice Teresa Cheng\'s residence, with her husband Jonathan Scott Poon\'s residence also suspected of unauthorized building works, among others.'}

{'text': '記協又指局方是在 2025 年 7 月提交相關修訂草案，提議收緊土地查冊，雖然事宜無急切性，但當局以「先立法、後審議」方式實施，變相剝削公眾和立法會表達意見，又指希望當局並非是以「『生米煮成熟飯』的方式來造成既定事實」。記協又舉當局收緊收車牌為例，指在 17宗傳媒提出的新聞用途的車牌資料申請中，僅 1 宗於拖延多時後獲部分批准，預料傳媒認為涉及公眾利益的土地查冊活動，或將面臨同樣阻撓。', 'paragraph_context': 'The HKJA also pointed out that the bureau submitted the relevant amendment draft in July 2025, proposing to tighten land searches. Although the matter is not urgent, the authorities implemented it in a "legislate first, review later" manner, effectively depriving the public and the Legislative Council of the opportunity to express their views. It also expressed hope that the authorities are not using a "fait accompli" approach to create established facts. The HKJA also cited the authorities\' tightening of vehicle registration plate searches as an example, noting that out of 17 media applications for news purposes, only one received partial approval after lengthy delays. It anticipates that media land search activities deemed to involve public interest may face similar obstruction.'}
